summary: Residential cul-de-sac head below the bush; homes close all round.
reasons: Ring itself is steep thick bush
Homes within about 20 m all round

best_section.where: Head of the cul-de-sac about 45 m south of the ring, beside the bush edge

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the north, but houses close on the west, east and south sides; nearest mapped house 40 m from ring.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street reaches it; bush edge has no visible track, so a van would stay on the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the street, but no camping seen.

flags: Steep: about 12% mean grade around the ring
Ring sits in bush with no track or tyre marks
Homes within about 25 m of the cul-de-sac head
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the north side; open sky over the sealed street.
